Place the DB-IP "IP to Country Lite" database here as:

    dbip-country-lite.mmdb

Download (no signup required): https://db-ip.com/db/download/ip-to-country-lite
Pick the .mmdb format, monthly release. License: CC BY 4.0 (attribution
required - already included in the TrafficLens admin dashboard footer).

Until this file is present, TrafficLens will still track visits normally;
country_code will just be stored as NULL.
